name: io.github.chrischall/opentable-mcp
description: OpenTable reservation management: find slots, book, cancel, list reservations, manage favorites.

environmentVariables.name: OT_BRIDGE
environmentVariables.description: Which browser transport to use: "websocket" (default, the fetchproxy bridge) or "mcp-chrome".

environmentVariables.name: OT_MCP_CHROME_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the mcp-chrome bridge (default http://127.0.0.1:12306/mcp). Only used when OT_BRIDGE=mcp-chrome.

environmentVariables.name: OT_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the fetchproxy WebSocket port (default 37149, the fleet-shared port).

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bridge bind interface, a literal IP only (anything else is ignored); default 127.0.0.1. Keep on loopback — it exists for a hosted child in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to store the long-term bridge identity keypair, an absolute path only (anything else is ignored); default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/. Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller.
